name: wechat-viral-topic
author: 诺声(Logos)@SynomosAI
purpose_en: Separates a real signal from a clickbait guess when choosing topics, and applies compliance red lines before any draft is written.
purpose_zh: 选题时把「真信号」与「标题党猜测」分开，并在动笔前先过合规红线。给出候选选题的证据强度分级，而不是热度数字。
use_when_en: Use when picking a WeChat/公众号 topic, judging whether a hot item is worth writing, or checking a draft for compliance risk before publishing.
use_when_zh: 为公众号选题、判断热点是否值得写、或发布前检查稿件合规风险时使用。
outputs_en: Topic candidates graded by evidence strength (signal / weak signal / guess), plus a red-line list naming the exact sentence that trips each rule.
outputs_zh: 按证据强度分级的候选选题（真信号/弱信号/猜测），以及点名到具体句子的红线清单。

intents.ask_en: Pick a WeChat 公众号 topic and grade it by evidence strength
intents.ask_zh: 为公众号选题并按证据强度分级

intents.ask_en: Decide whether a hot item is worth writing about or is just clickbait
intents.ask_zh: 判断一个热点值不值得写、还是标题党

intents.ask_en: Check a draft against compliance red lines before publishing
intents.ask_zh: 发布前检查稿件是否触碰合规红线

intents.ask_en: Detect whether my title overclaims what the body supports
intents.ask_zh: 检测标题是否超出正文能支撑的范围

intents_note: intents is a lookup surface, not a feature list: each ask is phrased the way a user or an agent would search it, and routes_to points at a real entrypoint in this package. 如果某条 ask 在本包做不到，那就是缺陷，应当删掉而不是留着。
